Created the skill. The generalizable insight worth saving was the terminology decode: in Treasury Bulletin savings-bond redemption tables, the obfuscated phrase "value buildup from the original price markdown" maps to the **accrued discount** line (value accumulated above the original discounted purchase price), which is a distinct component from principal/original-price redemptions. A future agent seeing similar phrasing would otherwise have to re-derive this mapping or risk picking the wrong line.

No memory update needed — this is captured as a procedural skill, not a cross-session fact, and the existing memory store is near capacity (98%). Done.
